$comment: Which Maestro flows the Android E2E workflow (.github/workflows/e2e.yml) runs, and on which emulator.
Each shard is one CI job with its OWN fresh emulator, running its flows in the order listed.
State does not cross shards: a flow that needs another flow's output (requires) must sit after it in the same shard.
Every .maestro/*.yaml flow must be in exactly one shard or listed under parked with the reason;
scripts/ci/e2eShards.test.mjs enforces this, so a new flow cannot silently stay out of CI.
A flow whose launchApp clears state must be the last of its shard (the same test checks that).

last.record.yaml: its save-vs-discard outcome is indeterminate, so nothing after it may count trails

parked.marine.yaml: Marine is parked behind MARINE_ENABLED (src/core/features/flags.ts); the flow cannot pass on the shipping build
parked.wind-motion.yaml: Weather is parked behind WEATHER_ENABLED; its driver is npm run wind:motion, not this runner
